design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (pass_membership_billing_and_benefits).

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed: prerequisite_problems 1, factor_counts [5, 6]. Tree = root pass_ext_plus_monthly_upgrade_charge (6 factors) + one prerequisite pass_ext_restoration_payment (5 factors). --tasks 2 showed task 1 draws 3 prerequisite problems with [6, 6, 5, 5]; task 0 claims only the past-due restoration and the move up to Plus Monthly, leaving the credit posting, the fare-adjustment credit correction, the full-refund-window refund and the move up to All Access Annual for task 1.

[Why it is a good test] The customer asks for one thing (move up to Plus Monthly). The base plan-change rule allows a change only on an active membership, and the extended upgrade-charge rule says the charge is worked out only after the billing period in force carries a collected membership fee. The membership is past_due (renewal declined 2026-10-08 and on the 2026-10-10 retry), so the agent must read the status and the ledger, see that the only write that puts a collected fee on the period is the member's own restoration payment, work that payment out (5 factors over the dunning ledger, tenure, trip ledger and credit spending), hand it to the member, and only then work out the upgrade charge (6 factors) on the world after that payment. Difficulty comes from reading two rules and the records and doing two layered calculations; each write has exactly one tool.

[Scope snapshot] Occupied before: nothing. Claimed: pass_ext_restoration_payment (restore_past_due_pass_5ad4a609, owner user) and pass_ext_plus_monthly_upgrade_charge (upgrade_pass_to_plus_monthly_9f7c0895, owner user). Left for task 1: credit posting, fare-adjustment credit correction, window refund, move up to All Access Annual. The two plan-change tools are split by target plan and billing subtype (monthly-billed Plus Monthly versus annual-billed All Access Annual).

[Problem-tree card] root pass_ext_plus_monthly_upgrade_charge <- pass_ext_restoration_payment. kind value_input, gate um_paid (fees collected for the period in force less refunds, which is the base of the unused-period credit), form state. policy_source (in the root rule): "The Plus Monthly upgrade charge is worked out only after the billing period in force carries a collected membership fee." Four-point test: (1) "only after", affirmative, joining this policy's result to a record state; negated rewrite "is not worked out until the billing period in force carries a collected membership fee" states the same condition; a billing desk states a charge as resting on a paid period. (2) XX is a record-visible state: a membership fee charge whose billing period start equals the membership's current period start. (3) no tool, policy id or code token. (4) hard requirement, scope exactly the period in force. condition (round 2): the ledger carries such a fee charge; the earlier extra clause about status was dropped so the condition says exactly what the sentence says. Exactly one write of this difficulty books a fee charge for a period already running: the restoration payment (renewal charge for the period in force). The plan-change tools book a charge for a NEW period (their own result); the refund tool removes money; the credit tools touch credit only. Derivation: sentence + ledger (period 2026-10-08 has only two pass_payment_decline rows, status past_due) + the restoration rule ("the payment is booked as a renewal fee charge for that period and the membership becomes active again with the same period dates") -> the member's restoration payment. Seed falsification: pass_memberships.status = past_due; declines for 2026-10-08 (retry 0) and 2026-10-10 (retry 1); no pass_fee_charge with billing_period_start 2026-10-08. Owner of the resolving tool: user. Order: restoration (step 7), then upgrade (step 9). Deletion sensitivity: skipping the restoration gives 16.39 instead of 7.59 (no collected fee, so no unused-period credit; the share falls back to 28/31). user_scenario never names the restoration, the decline or any owed amount. The tools check nothing.

[Round 2 closures] (G2) The full-refund-window refund is now owed only when the member ends the membership at once or moves up to All Access Annual, so a move up to Plus Monthly owes no refund. The restoration charge is two days inside the Monthly window, but no refund write belongs to this tree, and the earlier second reading (refund the restoration charge, then upgrade) no longer exists. (G1) The card-partner tier is gone. The unused-period credit is always taken on the fees collected for the period less refunds; this is the policy's standing method, stated in its baseline, not a factor. The sixth factor is now the Priority Pickup upgrade credit, with live tiers. Two Priority Pickup charges were seeded on Standard trips (2.99 each; Monthly waives none). (G3-c) The old basis condition, which tested gross collected against net paid, is gone with it. (Rounding) Every figure stated here and in the closure was recomputed with the published half-up rounding and with the evaluator. They agree, and no figure sits on a half-cent. While doing this, a seeded historical credit was found exactly on a half-cent: the 2026-09-03 trip would have earned 1.845. Its fare was set to 27.40, so its credit is 1.85 under both roundings.

[Base-invariant card] Write 1 (step 7), subjects pass_fee_charge + pass_payment_recover: pass_evt_fee_billing.billable_status "Membership fees are collected only on a membership in enrolled, trial, active or past_due status." -> past_due (system record, pre-action), correlated by pass_membership_id; pass_plan_change_rules lists fee charges for plan-change charges only (its active_membership gate applies to pass_plan_change) -> policy scope; pass_evt_payment_dunning -> collected within the 7-day dunning grace from 2026-10-08 (runs to 2026-10-15; 2026-10-11 inside), same period dates. pass_plan_change_rules appears in the restoration policy's lineage only because it lists fee charges among its subjects; it governs none of the restoration's quantities. Write 2 (step 9), subjects pass_plan_change + pass_fee_charge: pass_plan_change_rules.active_membership -> active after step 7; no earlier plan change in the period; Plus Monthly is in Monthly's upgrade_targets; the website signup is not a card partner offer. pass_student_verification -> not a Student move. pass_evt_fee_billing.billable_status -> active. No time-kind eligibility (temporal_feasibility []). Overwrites: the restoration supersedes only the fee clause of pass_evt_fee_billing, "The fee for a period is the plan's membership_fee;"; the period-end rule of the same base sentence stays in force. The upgrade supersedes pass_plan_change_rules' upgrade sentence (the unused value is taken on what was paid, with a timing share and discounts) and the same fee-billing sentence. No gate sentence is quoted, so every gate stays inherited. The card-partner sentences of base (no plan change, never billed by Wayfare) are followed.

[Business-object card] Target: the customer's one Wayfare Pass Monthly membership. Write 1 pays the declined renewal of billing period 2026-10-08..2026-11-07 (key billing_period_start = current_period_start). The 2026-05 decline/recovery pair belongs to period 2026-05-08: it is excluded from the attempt count and counted as one other declined scheduled renewal. Write 2 acts on the same membership; the unused-period credit takes the fee charges of billing period 2026-10-08 only (after write 1: the 8.80 restoration charge).

[Factor card: restoration payment] Baseline: full fee 9.99; fall-back 9.99.
- restored_period_share (method: day share vs month share vs full fee): 2 declined attempts < 3 retries + 1, monthly -> 28/31; baseline 9.69.
- loyalty_restoration_discount (multi-source: tenure x other declines): 19 months, 1 other decline (2026-05-08) -> 5 percent; near-miss on the 18-month first tier. Baseline 9.25.
- frequent_rider_restoration_discount (cross-difficulty trip ledger): 9 fare charges since 2026-07-12 -> 2 percent; near-miss: the 2026-07-09 fare. Baseline 8.98.
- credit_use_restoration_discount: 6.10 spent in six months -> 1 percent; near-miss: the 2.50 spent 2026-04-05 would lift it to 8.60. Baseline 8.89.
- payment_recovery_fee: 2 declined attempts -> 0.50; baseline 8.30.
- Expected 8.80 = 9.99 x 28/31 x 0.92 + 0.50 = 8.8014, rounded half up.

[Factor card: Plus Monthly upgrade charge] Baseline: 19.99 less fees collected for the period less refunds, times days share 28/31; fall-back 12.04.
- unused_period_share (method): latest fee charge 0 days old, inside the 2-day window, no credit posted for the period -> whole period. Near-miss: the 2026-10-09 trip completed while past due earned no credit. Baseline 8.44.
- loyalty_upgrade_discount (multi-source tenure x trips, cross-difficulty): 19 months and 9 trips -> 5 percent; baseline 8.59.
- comfort_rider_upgrade_discount (cross-difficulty): 2 trips (Comfort 08-15, Black 09-22; the Comfort trip of 01-22 is outside) -> 2 percent; baseline 7.99.
- reserve_rider_upgrade_credit (cross-difficulty): 1 reservation fee (2026-09-02) -> 1.00; baseline 8.59.
- airport_rider_upgrade_discount (cross-difficulty): 2 DEN airport trips -> 1 percent; baseline 7.79.
- priority_pickup_upgrade_credit (cross-difficulty): 2 Priority Pickup charges (2026-07-18, 2026-09-29) -> 1.00; baseline 8.59.
- Expected 7.59 = 19.99 x 0.92 - 1.00 - 1.00 - 8.80 = 7.5908, rounded half up.

[Seed rows]
- customers: Desmond Fairweather, DEN, phone 7205550133, DOB 1993-11-02, card 4127.
- pass_memberships: one Monthly membership, past_due, period 2026-10-08..2026-11-07; net_fees_paid 179.82 = 18 x 9.99; credit balance 15.21 = credit earned less credit spent.
- pass_events: 18 fee charges (trial conversion 2025-04-08; renewals on the 8th; the 2026-05 renewal collected on its 2026-05-10 retry); 3 declines; 15 credit earns, each recomputed with this charter's credit-posting rule (Green and Shared points, the frequent-rider point once 6 postings in three months and 12 months held, airport and Reserve points, rounded half up, monthly cap counted over the month before posting, never binding); 4 redemptions matched by member_credit_applied on their fare charges.
- trips/trip_charges: 17 completed DEN trips with fare charges (every credit-earning fare charge carries the membership, as the trip charter requires; the Black and past-due fares do not), 2 airport surcharges (5.00), 1 reservation fee (3.00 Standard) and 2 Priority Pickup charges (2.99 Standard). The 2026-09-22 Black trip earned no credit (not eligible on Monthly), nor did the 2026-10-09 trip (past due). Driver identity fields are empty: the drivers' profiles are outside this rider's closure.
- Automatic clauses: the dunning grace has not run out; no credit expiry, pause or student clause is lit.

[Persona] Desmond opens with the upgrade request. He gives his mobile number, then his date of birth when asked, with the card's last four as a fallback. He wants payments and the plan change done by himself. He never volunteers the past-due fact. If told something must be paid first, he pays the step handed to him, then makes the plan change, accepts the quoted amount, and closes on hearing he is on Plus Monthly.

[Verification run] Scratch evaluation through check_compute's own evaluator, cross-checked with half-up rounding: restoration 8.80 (sensitivities {'restored_period_share': 9.69, 'loyalty_restoration_discount': 9.25, 'frequent_rider_restoration_discount': 8.98, 'credit_use_restoration_discount': 8.89, 'payment_recovery_fee': 8.3}, fall-back 9.99); after replaying the restoration tool, upgrade 7.59 (sensitivities {'unused_period_share': 8.44, 'loyalty_upgrade_discount': 8.59, 'comfort_rider_upgrade_discount': 7.99, 'reserve_rider_upgrade_credit': 8.59, 'airport_rider_upgrade_discount': 7.79, 'priority_pickup_upgrade_credit': 8.59}, fall-back 12.04); without the restoration, 16.39. Per-task gates are run after assembly (see the final gate block).

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the published rules (plan change only on an active membership; upgrade charge only after the period carries a collected fee; the window refund owed only on ending at once or moving to All Access Annual; restoration and upgrade rules), the share tools' rows and the persona: act now (the member agrees to pay); object = the single membership; order = restoration, then upgrade. Restoration 9.99 x 28/31 x 0.92 + 0.50 = 8.80. Upgrade 19.99 x 0.92 - 1.00 - 1.00 - 8.80 x 1 = 7.59. Agrees with gold.


[Round 3 worklog] Nothing in this task's tree changed. The charter edit (the credit-posting cap declaration, R2-N1) concerns a policy outside this tree. O1: 'before the call' was removed from the tools' Id-class Args lines; the tracing quotes of this task never included it. Scored values unchanged: restoration 8.80, upgrade 7.59; skip figure 16.39.

[Round 4 worklog, KB audit policy-side note 2] The overwrites of pass_evt_fee_billing in pass_ext_restoration_payment and pass_ext_plus_monthly_upgrade_charge (and pass_ext_all_access_upgrade_charge) now quote only "The fee for a period is the plan's membership_fee;". The period-end rule stays in force: the restoration keeps the period dates, and the upgrade tool sets the new period's last day by it. No figure of this task moved (restoration 8.80, upgrade 7.59, skip 16.39).
user_scenario: You are Desmond Fairweather, a 32-year-old hospital lab technician in Denver who rides Wayfare a few times a month and has had a Wayfare Pass on the Monthly plan since March 2025. You are calling (or chatting) because you want to move your Pass up to Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly today: lately you have been taking Comfort rides and the odd Black ride, plus airport runs to DEN, and a friend told you Plus gives a bigger ride credit and a discount on Comfort. You open with something like: "Hi, I'd like to upgrade my Wayfare Pass to Plus Monthly today, please." To find your account you give your mobile number, 7205550133, and only when the agent asks you to confirm who you are do you give your date of birth, 1993-11-02 (November 2, 1993); if they want one more detail you can read the last four digits of the card on your profile, 4127. Your email is desmond.fairweather@outlook.com if anyone asks for it. You are happy for the agent to look things up, but you want the plan change itself and any payment to be done by you, from your own app, once they set it up for you; you do not want anyone charging you without you pressing the button. You do not know how the upgrade price is worked out and you do not ask for a breakdown beyond what the agent offers. Only if the agent tells you that something on the membership has to be paid or brought up to date before the plan can change do you react: you sigh that your old card was replaced last week and say you will take care of it right now with your new card, and when the agent hands you that payment step you complete it yourself and read back what your app shows. When the agent then hands you the plan change step, you complete it yourself as well and read back the confirmation. If the agent quotes you an upgrade amount, you accept it; you have no figure of your own to compare it with. Once you hear that you are on Plus Monthly, you thank the agent and end the conversation. If you are asked whether you want anything else, you say no.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's Wayfare profile from the mobile number he states, returning the customer reference number and the profile details used for verification.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later lookup and both membership writes are keyed on this customer reference number; without it the membership cannot be found.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record a passed identity check using the two details the caller states (mobile number and date of birth).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be verified before any membership detail is discussed or any membership charge or plan change is made.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the membership: plan Wayfare Pass Monthly, status past_due, period 2026-10-08 to 2026-11-07, enrolled 2025-03-09, signed up on the website.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The plan change rule allows a change only on an active membership and the upgrade charge waits on a collected fee for the period in force; the past_due status read here shows that fee is missing, and the enrollment date sets the tenure tiers of both computations.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the membership ledger: the monthly fee charges, the declined renewal attempts of 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-10 for the period in force, the earlier declined renewal of 2026-05-08, and the Pass ride credit earned and spent.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows that no fee has been collected for the period in force (the state the upgrade charge waits on), gives the two declined attempts behind the restored-period share and the payment recovery fee, the one other declined renewal behind the loyalty restoration discount, and the credit spent in the last six months behind the credit-use restoration discount.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's trips: ride options, drop-off times and airport legs, including the Comfort trip of 2026-08-15, the Black trip of 2026-09-22 and the DEN airport trips of 2026-08-02 and 2026-09-29.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The Comfort-rider and airport-rider upgrade discounts take their tiers from the completed trips dropped off in the last three months.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's trip charges: the fare charges with their dates (nine on or after 2026-07-12, one on 2026-07-09 just outside the window), the reservation fee of 2026-09-02 and the Priority Pickup charges of 2026-07-18 and 2026-09-29.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The frequent-rider restoration discount and the loyalty upgrade discount count fare charges in the last three months; the Reserve-rider and Priority Pickup upgrade credits count the reservation fees and Priority Pickup charges in that window.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the member's own restoration payment action so it can be handed to him.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair for the restoration payment; no database effect, unlocked once.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The member pays the past-due renewal of the period in force: a renewal fee charge of the restoration payment is booked for 2026-10-08 and the membership becomes active with the same period dates.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The upgrade charge is worked out only after the billing period in force carries a collected membership fee; this is the one write that brings that state about, and the restoration payment rule fixes its amount.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 8.80. Restoration payment rule on the world at frozen_time: membership fee 9.99 (Wayfare Pass Monthly). Restored-period share (method): a monthly plan whose period's renewal shows 2 declined attempts (2026-10-08 retry 0, 2026-10-10 retry 1), fewer than the plan's 3 retries plus one, so the share is the days from 2026-10-11 through 2026-11-07 both counted (28) over the 31 days of the period 2026-10-08..2026-11-07; the baseline full fee would give 9.99. Loyalty restoration discount: held 19 whole months since 2025-03-09 and one other declined scheduled renewal in the last 12 months (2026-05-08), so not the 10 percent tier; 19 >= 6 and at most one -> 5 percent. Frequent-rider restoration discount: 9 trips charged a fare since 2026-07-12 (07-18, 07-30, 08-02, 08-15, 08-27, 09-03, 09-22, 09-29, 10-09; the 07-09 fare is outside the three-month window) -> 6 to 11 -> 2 percent. Credit-use restoration discount: credit spent in the last six months 3.10 + 1.60 + 1.40 = 6.10 (the 2.50 spent on 2026-04-05 is outside) -> 4.00 or more but under 8.00 -> 1 percent. Combined discount 0.08 applied once: 9.99 x 28/31 x 0.92 = 8.3014. Payment recovery fee: exactly two declined attempts -> 0.50. Total 8.8014 rounded half up once -> 8.80.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.proration_charge: 7.59. Plus Monthly upgrade charge rule on the world after the restoration payment of 8.80: Plus Monthly fee 19.99. Fees collected for the period 2026-10-08 less refunds = 8.80 (the restoration charge; no refund). Unused-period share (method): the latest fee charge is dated 2026-10-11, 0 days old, within the Monthly plan's 2-day full refund window, and no Pass ride credit has been posted for the period, so the share is the whole period (1); the baseline would take 28/31. Unused-period credit 8.80 x 1 = 8.80. Loyalty upgrade discount: 19 months held and 9 fare trips in three months -> not 24/20, but 12/6 -> 5 percent. Comfort-rider upgrade discount: completed Comfort/Black trips dropped off in three months = 2 (2026-08-15 Comfort, 2026-09-22 Black) -> 2 percent. Airport-rider upgrade discount: 2 airport trips (2026-08-02 pickup, 2026-09-29 dropoff) -> 1 percent. Combined 0.08 applied once: 19.99 x 0.92 = 18.3908. Reserve-rider upgrade credit: 1 reservation fee (2026-09-02) -> 1.00. Priority Pickup upgrade credit: 2 Priority Pickup charges (2026-07-18, 2026-09-29) -> 1.00. 18.3908 - 1.00 - 1.00 - 8.80 = 7.5908, never below 0.00, rounded half up once -> 7.59. A window refund of the restoration charge is not owed: the full-refund-window rule refunds a period fee only when the member ends the membership at once or moves up to All Access Annual.

Basis: the tool docstring asks for 'the Wayfare Pass membership reference number being moved up, as returned by the membership lookup'; the customer's only membership. edges.condition: The membership ledger carries a membership fee charge whose billing period start equals the membership's current period start.
edges.policy_source: The Plus Monthly upgrade charge is worked out only after the billing period in force carries a collected membership fee.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The membership is past_due: the renewal for the period starting 2026-10-08 was declined on 2026-10-08 and on the 2026-10-10 retry, and the ledger carries no fee charge whose billing period start is 2026-10-08.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The restoration payment books a renewal fee charge of 8.80 for billing period 2026-10-08 and sets status active, so the fees collected for the period become 8.80.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single prerequisite edge: the restoration payment must precede the upgrade charge. No parallel prerequisites exist, so there is no alternative order to compare.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the restoration payment leaves no fee collected for the period and the membership past_due: the Plus Monthly upgrade charge recomputes to 16.39 instead of 7.59 (no unused-period credit; the share falls back to 28/31 because the latest fee charge is the 2026-09-08 one), the 2026-10-08 renewal fee row is missing and the status stays past_due in the terminal state. Both figures are the same under the published half-up rounding and the evaluator's rounding.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only for the move to Plus Monthly; it never mentions the declined renewal, the past-due status, the restoration payment or any amount owed. The member reacts only if the agent first says something has to be paid or brought up to date, and then only agrees and completes the step handed to him.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: upgrade_pass_to_plus_monthly_9f7c0895 reads the membership only to copy its customer and net fees, then creates the plan change fee charge and updates the plan and period unconditionally; it never inspects the status or the period's payments and returns no error, so on a past_due membership it still writes. restore_past_due_pass_5ad4a609 likewise writes without checking anything.
